crossbow.name: Light crossbow
crossbow.description: Accurate short/mid-range bolt punch; 3 AP shot, explicit 4 AP / 14 fatigue reload. Two hands; cannot reload while engaged.

shortsword.name: Short sword
shortsword.description: Quick, accurate cuts; weak against armour.

falchion.name: Falchion
falchion.description: Heavy cutting damage; lower penetration than the arming sword.

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.description: A heavy two-handed cut; commits most of the turn and gives up a shield.

militia_spear.name: Light militia spear
militia_spear.description: Easy to place and sustain; poor penetration and armour damage.

heavy_spear.name: Heavy spear
heavy_spear.description: Stronger penetrating thrusts; slower and more tiring.

hatchet.name: Belt hatchet
hatchet.description: A lighter chopping weapon; trades impact for speed and stamina.

greataxe.name: Two-handed axe
greataxe.description: Devastating armour damage; awkward, tiring and leaves no shield hand.

club.name: Ironbound club
club.description: Cheap control weapon with low impact.

maul.name: Two-handed maul
maul.description: Extreme armour wear and high fatigue.

knife.name: Belt knife
knife.description: Cheap, light backup; short blade limits damage.

glaive.name: Long glaive
glaive.description: Greater reach-strike damage; exactly two hexes and a costly swing.

shortbow.name: Hunting shortbow
shortbow.description: Light bow with short range and poor penetration.

warbow.name: Heavy warbow
warbow.description: Long range and strong arrows; demands stamina and aim.

heavy_crossbow.name: Heavy crossbow
heavy_crossbow.description: Heavy armour-piercing punch with less accuracy, more load and higher price; 3 AP shot, explicit 4 AP / 20 fatigue reload. Cannot reload while engaged.

javelins.name: Javelin bundle
javelins.description: Five throws per bundle. Usable while engaged; compatible with a shield. Refills from company ammunition: 3 per throw.

throwing_axes.name: Throwing axe bundle
throwing_axes.description: Five throws per bundle. Usable while engaged; compatible with a shield. Refills from company ammunition: 3 per throw.

bolas.name: Bolas bundle
bolas.description: Five throws per bundle; costs 3 company ammo per refill. Uses ordinary throwing attacks; entanglement is not implemented.

short_sword.name: Short sword
short_sword.role: Reliable close sword; tighter floor, economical, less penetration than Quarry.
short_sword.description: Reliable close sword; tighter floor, economical, less penetration than Quarry.

cudgel.name: Iron cudgel
cudgel.role: Sustainable blunt/control weapon; lower impact and penetration than War mace.
cudgel.description: Sustainable blunt/control weapon; lower impact and penetration than War mace.

pike.name: Ash pike
pike.role: Tight-roll line spear with brace; no shield and no one-hand discount/pose fiction.
pike.description: Tight-roll line spear with brace; no shield and no one-hand discount/pose fiction.

short_bow.name: Short bow
short_bow.role: Compact low-burden close-support bow profile; shares Reedrunner paint, not a distinct short-bow silhouette.
short_bow.description: Compact low-burden close-support bow profile; shares Reedrunner paint, not a distinct short-bow silhouette.

hm_trial_v1:old24-shieldbearer_heavy.name: War mace
hm_trial_v1:old24-shieldbearer_heavy.role: Armour-working control mace; more impact, worse accuracy, fatigue and load. Not a hammer/shatter alias.
hm_trial_v1:old24-shieldbearer_heavy.description: Armour-working control mace; more impact, worse accuracy, fatigue and load. Not a hammer/shatter alias.

hm_trial_v1:old24-archer_weapon.name: Ash longbow
hm_trial_v1:old24-archer_weapon.role: Longer-range general bow: reach rather than free damage upgrade; less accurate and heavier than short profile.
hm_trial_v1:old24-archer_weapon.description: Longer-range general bow: reach rather than free damage upgrade; less accurate and heavier than short profile.

hm_trial_v1:old24-archer_heavy.name: Heavy hunting bow
hm_trial_v1:old24-archer_heavy.role: Close/mid-range heavy hunting punch: more armour impact, poorer placement, shorter reach than Ash longbow, costly sustain.
hm_trial_v1:old24-archer_heavy.description: Close/mid-range heavy hunting punch: more armour impact, poorer placement, shorter reach than Ash longbow, costly sustain.

hm_trial_v1:old24-polearm_weapon.name: Boar spear
hm_trial_v1:old24-polearm_weapon.role: Boar spear trades placement/sustain for a wider impact ceiling and armour wear, with existing brace.
hm_trial_v1:old24-polearm_weapon.description: Boar spear trades placement/sustain for a wider impact ceiling and armour wear, with existing brace.

hm_trial_v1:old24-polearm_heavy.name: Billhook
hm_trial_v1:old24-polearm_heavy.role: Billhook: rear-rank reach/hook, higher raw impact than Ferryman; adjacent -15 without mastery.
hm_trial_v1:old24-polearm_heavy.description: Billhook: rear-rank reach/hook, higher raw impact than Ferryman; adjacent -15 without mastery.

hm_trial_v1:old24-duelist_weapon.name: Narrow sabre
hm_trial_v1:old24-duelist_weapon.role: Light sabre: better placement and lighter kit; wider/lower floor and weaker armour wear than Short sword.
hm_trial_v1:old24-duelist_weapon.description: Light sabre: better placement and lighter kit; wider/lower floor and weaker armour wear than Short sword.

hm_trial_v1:old24-duelist_heavy.name: Heavy falchion
hm_trial_v1:old24-duelist_heavy.role: Broad cutting blade: high flesh roll, weaker placement/penetration and heavier/more tiring.
hm_trial_v1:old24-duelist_heavy.description: Broad cutting blade: high flesh roll, weaker placement/penetration and heavier/more tiring.

hm_trial_v1:old24-medic_weapon.name: Field knife
hm_trial_v1:old24-medic_weapon.role: Light accurate flesh/backup knife and cheaper Puncture; low armour work.
hm_trial_v1:old24-medic_weapon.description: Light accurate flesh/backup knife and cheaper Puncture; low armour work.

hm_trial_v1:old24-medic_heavy.name: Surgical hatchet
hm_trial_v1:old24-medic_heavy.role: Light swingy chopping tool; same fixed Split shield effect at less fatigue/load, less impact.
hm_trial_v1:old24-medic_heavy.description: Light swingy chopping tool; same fixed Split shield effect at less fatigue/load, less impact.

hm_trial_v1:old24-ward_spear.name: Ward Spear
hm_trial_v1:old24-ward_spear.role: Accurate economical brace/line spear; weaker damage and armour wear. No magical ward.
hm_trial_v1:old24-ward_spear.description: Accurate economical brace/line spear; weaker damage and armour wear. No magical ward.

hm_trial_v1:old24-gatewarden_blade.name: Gatewarden's Blade
hm_trial_v1:old24-gatewarden_blade.role: Stout blade: better armour wear than falchion, lower damage ceiling and larger sustained cost. Not a higher tier.
hm_trial_v1:old24-gatewarden_blade.description: Stout blade: better armour wear than falchion, lower damage ceiling and larger sustained cost. Not a higher tier.

hm_trial_v1:old24-reedrunner_bow.name: Reedrunner Bow
hm_trial_v1:old24-reedrunner_bow.role: Accurate midrange field bow: less raw damage/armour wear, more fatigue/load than Short bow; exactly shared artwork.
hm_trial_v1:old24-reedrunner_bow.description: Accurate midrange field bow: less raw damage/armour wear, more fatigue/load than Short bow; exactly shared artwork.

hm_trial_v1:old24-ferryman_hook.name: Ferryman's Hook
hm_trial_v1:old24-ferryman_hook.role: Armour-biased hook: gives up hit chance, raw damage, fatigue and load for armour work; same actual drag, no extra displacement.
hm_trial_v1:old24-ferryman_hook.description: Armour-biased hook: gives up hit chance, raw damage, fatigue and load for armour work; same actual drag, no extra displacement.

hm_trial_v1:old24-quarry_estoc.name: Quarry Estoc
hm_trial_v1:old24-quarry_estoc.role: Accurate penetrating point/parrying silhouette; lower raw damage and armour wear. Uses existing Riposte, not passive parry defence.
hm_trial_v1:old24-quarry_estoc.description: Accurate penetrating point/parrying silhouette; lower raw damage and armour wear. Uses existing Riposte, not passive parry defence.

hm_trial_v1:old24-wayfarer_lancet.name: Wayfarer's Lancet
hm_trial_v1:old24-wayfarer_lancet.role: Direct-penetrating point against remaining armour, not a strict higher knife; weaker raw rolls and costlier Puncture.
hm_trial_v1:old24-wayfarer_lancet.description: Direct-penetrating point against remaining armour, not a strict higher knife; weaker raw rolls and costlier Puncture.

hm_trial_v1:additional_fighting_axe.name: Fighting axe
hm_trial_v1:additional_fighting_axe.role: Heavier armour-working axe; sacrifices accuracy, sequencing, fatigue and load. Medic-only fitted art.
hm_trial_v1:additional_fighting_axe.description: Heavier armour-working axe; sacrifices accuracy, sequencing, fatigue and load. Medic-only fitted art.

hm_trial_v1:twohand_sword.name: Two-handed sword option
hm_trial_v1:twohand_sword.role: One committed two-handed strike; no shield, no double-grip bonus, no Riposte; medic-only upright art.
hm_trial_v1:twohand_sword.description: One committed two-handed strike; no shield, no double-grip bonus, no Riposte; medic-only upright art.

hm_trial_v1:twohand_maul.name: Two-Handed Maul
hm_trial_v1:twohand_maul.description: Extreme armour wear and high fatigue.
